name: crisis-moments
title: Moments to review
description: Finds moments in a video where a person may be in distress or in conflict, for a person to look at: screaming or shouting, crying, struggling to breathe, hitting sounds, words of distress or about harming oneself, and aggressive words. It uses fixed rules on what other steps found, says what was heard and never what it means. It does not tell a panic attack or a mental health crisis from anything else, and it is not a safety system.

find.title: Find moments to review
find.description: Joins what was said, the sounds heard and how loud it was into moments that may need a look: screaming, shouting, crying, fast breathing, hitting sounds, words of distress (including words about harming oneself) and aggressive words. Give at least one of the three lists. A moment with more than one kind of evidence is more sure. Loudness only supports the others: a loud sound alone is not a moment. The labels describe what was heard; they never say that a crisis, a panic attack or an attack happened. Not a safety system: use it to find moments to review, not to decide anything about a person.

text.title: Sentences said
text.description: What was said, with times (for example the sentences of speech-to-text).

labels.title: Sounds or things found
labels.description: Sounds or things found, with times (for example the events of sound-events).

volume.title: Loudness over time
volume.description: The level over time in dB (for example the windows of sound-volume). It only supports the other two lists.

languages.title: Languages of the words
languages.description: The built-in lists of words to use: en English, pt Portuguese, es Spanish, fr French, de German (default English only). Give every language the video has: a language that is not listed finds nothing. The lists are written by a language model and not checked by a native speaker. A list you give yourself (distressWords, selfHarmWords, aggressionWords) replaces the built-in lists of its kind.

distressWords.title: Words of distress
distressWords.description: Words or phrases of a person in distress (a cry for help, not being able to breathe, fear, "stop"), as whole words. Replaces the built-in lists of this kind, whatever languages is.

selfHarmWords.title: Words about harming oneself
selfHarmWords.description: Words or phrases about ending one's own life or hurting oneself. One of them is enough to make a moment. Replaces the built-in lists of this kind.

aggressionWords.title: Aggressive words
aggressionWords.description: Threats and insults, as whole words. Replaces the built-in lists of this kind.

soundNames.title: Sounds that count
soundNames.description: Parts of sound names that flag a found sound. Replaces the built-in list (scream, shout, yell, cry, sob, whimper, wail, gasp, pant, slap, thump, grunt...).

wordsWindowMs.title: Words said close together
wordsWindowMs.description: Words of one kind said within this many milliseconds of the first one count together, even in different sentences, so "Help! I can't breathe! I'm going to die!" counts as three words (default 10000).

loudnessJumpDb.title: Loud voice
loudnessJumpDb.description: How many dB above the usual level a window must be to count as support for a sound or words (default 15). Loudness alone never makes a moment.

mergeGapMs.title: Join hints closer than
mergeGapMs.description: Hints this close in time make one moment (default 2000).

threshold.title: Least sure to show
threshold.description: Moments less sure than this are dropped (default 0.5).

failures.description: No list was given, or a list or a setting is wrong (a language with no list, a word that is not text).
